## Episode Thesis

Macro-focused Börslunch episode the day after the Swedish election. SEB's Amanda Sundström is worried about rising bond yields, especially in France. She thinks the ECB and possibly the Fed risk a policy mistake by tightening into an oil-price shock of around $107/bbl. The election result was fragmented, which the market read as lowering the risk of drastic reforms and lifted politically exposed stocks such as banks and school and care operators. Evelina Anttila discussed AI-safety fears after an Anthropic researcher's warning. That warning, together with talk of an AI bubble, pushed down Nasdaq futures and Stockholm tech-adjacent names.
